findings.summary: Required behavior #5 is entirely unimplemented. The spec requires a pointer — in the /quota response OR in documentation — telling readers that lingzhi quota is now served by quota-api at :8101/api/quotas, so that later maintainers do not conclude the feature was lost. Searching the whole tree for '8101', 'quota-api', 'api/quotas', 'zhiyuan' and '灵智' yields hits only inside .dev-dispatch protocol evidence (spec and the Continuous review); no product file, doc, comment or log message carries the pointer. The docs/ alternative the spec explicitly permits was available in this worktree regardless of the missing /quota endpoint, so the item was achievable and was simply skipped. The migration's own doc comment (schema.rs:1282-1286) explains the retirement but names no replacement out.

The migration selects rows by the literal provider id 'lingzhi' only, with no fallback on provider name, settings_config, or usage_script content. This app's add-provider path assigns a random UUID as the provider id for claude/codex apps (src/lib/query/mutations.ts:40), so if the deployed lingzhi row was created through the UI its id is a UUID and the migration silently no-ops — reproducing exactly the 'survives restart' failure that spec item 2 exists to prevent. The failure is invisible: the function logs '迁移完成' unconditionally at schema.rs:1348 whether or not any row was updated. Existing fixtures use a slug id, so the literal match may hold in the target deployment, but nothing in the change verifies or reports that it did.

The idempotence assertion does not exercise the migration body a second time. The second call to apply_schema_migrations_on_conn runs after user_version was already set to 12, so the `while version < SCHEMA_VERSION` loop is skipped and migrate_v11_to_v12 is never re-entered; the test proves the migration runner is a no-op at the target version, not that the migration itself is idempotent. Spec verification asks for '连续执行两次不报错、结果一致' of the migration. Calling Database::migrate_v11_to_v12 (or resetting user_version to 11) before the second assertion would close this.

The two unit tests named in the spec's Verification section (lingzhi billing_unit() returns None when usage_script.enabled=false; codex OAuth billing_unit() behavior unchanged) do not exist and cannot exist here: src-tauri/src/proxy/quota.rs and any billing_unit()/is_codex_oauth() symbol are absent from this worktree, which does not carry the /quota endpoint the spec targets. The implementation substitutes DB-layer assertions on providers.meta, which is a reasonable stand-in for the config-side lever (has_usage_script_enabled at src-tauri/src/provider.rs:80-86 does read meta.usage_script.enabled), but the end-to-end effect on billing_unit() is unverified in this tree. Flagging as context for the gap rather than as implementer fault.

Required behavior #4 (remove LINGZHI_ACCESS_TOKEN, written in `export VAR=value` form, from /data/cc-switch/cc-switch.env while retaining LINGZHI_API_KEY) concerns a file outside the repository and is not evidenced by any tracked file or committed record. It could not be confirmed or refuted by read-only inspection of this worktree and is not counted toward the verdict.
